topic.title: Work as an Author
topic.shortdesc: Authors use to manage projects, edit content, run reviews, publish deliverables, and work with AI-assisted features.

body.p: This section explains the main tasks for users who create, manage, review, and publish content in .

Authors have access to project-based functionality. They can work with repositories, edit content in a personal workspace, create review tasks, integrate feedback, configure publications and deliverables, and manage project settings.

ul.li: Edit content in a personal workspace.

section.title: How to use this section
section.p: Start with Projects overview. Then continue with Personal workspace and Project review tasks. For publishing workflows, see Publications and Deliverables. For advanced authoring support, see AI functionality and Project settings and members.
